need.evidence: Operators clearly struggle to locate leaks (alarm wires broken or missing, drones winter-only, days of digging) and one operator wants a larger pilot, but losses and costs are not quantified.

benefits.evidence: Field position error fell from 9.4 m to 2.1 m with about 120 EUR of parts per sensor, but price, installation cost, savings per leak and false-alarm handling at scale are not stated.

team.evidence: One doctoral researcher wants to found a company in 2027, the senior inventor will only advise, and nobody in the team has business experience.
